name: Config Translation PO
project_description:
INTRODUCTION 

Translation of configs is complicated. For example there is a UI to translate UI strings of Views, but to use it and effectively find where to translate a certain string is way beyond the knowledge of an average site editor or translator. The Config Translation PO module can export the translatable configuration strings to a standard PO file for third party processing. After the translation the module is able to import the strings from the PO file to Drupal's configuration.

 REQUIREMENTS 

This module requires Locale and Config Translation modules.

 INSTALLATION 

Install the Config Translation PO module as a contributed Drupal module would generally be installed. Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 UTILIZATION 

Navigate to config translation admin page.

 
 For export click on Export tab and set form elements to desired values, then submit form. 
 For import click on Import tab and set form elements to desired values, then submit form.
